content.text: I'll get a preview from the disconnect tool first. Nothing is deleted until you confirm.

Here is what the delete would do. Nothing has been changed yet.

**Local Google data currently stored:**
- **Google API data (`google` provider):** 3 daily step records, Oct 1–3, 2026.
- **Takeout data (`google_takeout`):** 1 daily step record, Oct 1, 2026. This is the copy you want to keep, and it is excluded from this action.

**Actions the tool will take:**
1. Remove the locally stored Google tokens. This only removes the copy on this computer. The app will no longer be able to use Google's access from here.
2. Cancel any active Google jobs.
3. Permanently delete the local Google records and the retained raw Google API responses.

**What it will not do:**
- It will not revoke Google's authorization. The app stays authorized at Google, so you can reconnect later without re-consenting. I have set revocation to off.
- It will not delete your Takeout copy. The tool keeps the `google_takeout` records and the extracted Takeout files.

Deleted local data can't be recovered from this app. You can re-import it from Google later if the API still has it.

Do you want me to proceed? Reply "yes" to confirm. The confirmation token expires in 5 minutes, so I'll need to request a new one if you wait longer.
